promotion_rule: Selection solve count must not decrease; break ties by total Lean calls including initial state. Final is evaluated once after all choices freeze. No production authority.
cost_accounting: Include primitive audit, discovery, falsification, marginal-utility paired searches, model training, evaluation, independent replay and cold construction; dependency install excluded explicitly.
contamination: No reference proofs in tasks; shared primitive laws explicit. Final goals/solutions never enter labels, retrieval library admission or checkpoint selection. Exact alpha-equivalent evaluation lemmas excluded.
claim: Public authored mathematical transfer; no prior-art novelty or general mathematical intelligence claim.
prospective_revision_note: Before fitting any model or evaluating any final task, training-only action-coverage probes showed the need for induction under hypotheses. Added predicate/function induction tasks. Initial 34-task protocol is retained unchanged; all original tasks remain. No positive selection proofs or final outcomes inspected. Two declared negative selection tasks were used solely for fresh-kernel counterexample smoke; they never enter training labels. Selection is development data, not a private untouched set. Final remains unevaluated.
